title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
Social Media Content Creator

Company: All Angles Real Estate Media (AAREM)

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Compensation: $5.00 USD per hour

Hours: 25–40 hours per week



About Us

All Angles Real Estate Media is a rapidly growing real estate media company serving Florida and Minnesota. We specialize in professional real estate photography, cinematic video, drone photography, virtual tours, floor plans, and social media marketing for real estate professionals and local businesses.



We're looking for a reliable, creative, and detail-oriented Social Media Content Creator to help grow the online presence of All Angles Real Estate Media while supporting our expanding social media services for clients.



This is a long-term opportunity with room for increased hours and advancement as our business continues to grow.



Responsibilities

As our Social Media Content Creator, you'll be responsible for creating, scheduling, and publishing engaging content across multiple social media platforms for both All Angles Real Estate Media and our clients.



Using Vista Social (or an equivalent social media management platform), you'll follow established workflows to ensure content is consistently published on schedule while maintaining each brand's unique voice and identity.



Daily Responsibilities

• Create graphics, reels, short-form videos, stories, and promotional content

• Schedule and publish content across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn

• Manage multiple social media accounts using Vista Social (or a similar scheduling platform)

• Build and maintain content calendars

• Repurpose photos, videos, and marketing assets into engaging social media content

• Write compelling captions using AI tools and your own creativity

• Optimize posts with hashtags, keywords, and platform best practices

• Monitor post performance and recommend improvements

• Research current social media trends and content ideas

• Maintain consistent branding across all client accounts

• Assist with additional marketing and administrative projects

• Perform other duties as assigned



Preferred Skills



Experience with the following is a plus:

• Canva

• CapCut

• Vista Social

• Meta Business Suite

• Adobe Express

• Adobe Creative Suite

• ChatGPT or other AI tools

• Basic video editing

• Basic graphic design

• Social media scheduling platforms



What We're Looking For

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Strong attention to detail

• Creative mindset

• Organized and dependable

• Ability to follow processes and deadlines

• Comfortable managing multiple client accounts

• Fast learner

• Self-motivated with minimal supervision

• Positive attitude and willingness to grow with our company

• Reliable high-speed internet connection

• Modern computer capable of handling large photo and video files



Schedule

• Monday – Friday

• 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Philippines Time (PHT)

• 25–40 hours per week

This is a full-time daytime schedule based in the Philippines while supporting a growing U.S.-based company.



Compensation & Growth

• Starting pay: $5.00 USD per hour

• 25–40 hours per week

• Long-term position

• Opportunity for additional hours as our client base grows

• Opportunities for advancement into additional marketing and administrative responsibilities

• Work directly with the owner of a growing U.S.-based media company



How to Apply

Please include the following with your application:

• Resume

• Portfolio or examples of social media work (if available)

• Internet speed test results

• Computer specifications

• List of software and AI tools you're familiar with

• A short paragraph explaining why you'd be a great fit for this position



To confirm you've read the entire posting, begin your application with:

AAREM Social Media Application



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be considered.



We look forward to meeting you and growing together!

title: Skool Community manager
description:
About Us:

We’re a fast-growing credit repair and financial consulting company based in Florida, serving clients in all 50 states. We run a Skool community teaching DIY and do for you credit repair, and we’re ready to scale it aggressively.



What You’ll Do:



• Manage and grow our Skool community day to day

• Build out course content structure, modules, and classroom organization inside Skool

• Drive engagement: posts, polls, challenges, leaderboards, and member onboarding

• Set up and optimize our tiered offer structure (free to paid conversion)

• Create funnels and strategies to bring new members in and keep them active

• Report weekly on growth, engagement, and conversion numbers



What You Must Have:



• Hands-on experience managing or growing a Skool community (not just a member, an operator)

• Knowledge of credit repair, credit scores, or the financial services space (US market)

• Strong written English, confident and direct communication style

• Experience with community monetization, memberships, or course platforms

• Self-starter who executes without hand-holding



Bonus Points:



• Experience with GoHighLevel

• Copywriting or content creation skills

• Familiarity with US credit bureaus, disputes, and FCRA basics



How to Apply:

Start your application with the word “OWL” so I know you read this. Then tell me:



1. A Skool community you’ve managed or grown (link or proof)

2. Your credit repair knowledge in 2-3 sentences

3. Your rate and availability



Applications without proof of Skool experience will be skipped.

title: Home Health Physical Therapy Coordinator
description:
Job Description:



We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized professional with a background in Home Health Physical Therapy to support clinical documentation and administrative operations. This role focuses on ensuring accurate patient intake, maintaining complete and compliant records, and supporting efficient coordination between therapists and scheduling systems in a home health setting.



Key Responsibilities:



- Manage patient intake processes specific to home health cases, ensuring accurate and complete information collection

- Maintain and update patient records in accordance with home health documentation standards

- Review clinical notes for completeness, accuracy, and appropriate medical justification

- Upload, organize, and track therapy documentation within the designated system or EMR

- Assist with scheduling of home health visits and coordination of therapist calendars

- Monitor documentation compliance and follow up on missing or incomplete notes

- Support communication between therapists, patients, and administrative teams to ensure timely workflow

- Ensure all records align with home health regulatory and agency requirements



Qualifications:



- Background in Home Health Physical Therapy or experience in a home health clinical setting preferred

- Familiarity with home health documentation, intake processes, and compliance requirements

- Strong understanding of medical terminology and clinical documentation standards

- Experience with EMR systems and scheduling tools

- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

- Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced healthcare environment

- Strong communication and coordination skills



Application Requirement:



Interested applicants are required to submit their updated resume for evaluation.

title: Credit Report & Dispute Specialist
description:
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–11:00 AM Central Time

Daily Check-In: 7:30 AM Central Time

Hours: 15 hours per week

Hourly Pay: $7 per hour

Paychecks are paid every 15th and 30th of each month



TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION, FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS AT THE END OF THIS APPLICATION



This position will begin at 15 hours per week. Our goal is to increase the specialist’s hours as the 850 Club Membership grows. Applicants should prepare to work more hours as more members join.



About the Position



850 Club Credit is hiring an experienced Credit Report & Dispute Specialist to manage client disputes, educate our members, and answer credit-report-related questions inside our online community.



This is not simply a letter-processing position. We need someone who can carefully review credit reports, identify potential reporting issues, prepare accurate disputes, track results, and explain the process in an easy-to-understand way.



Primary Responsibilities

Review three-bureau credit reports.

Identify potentially inaccurate, incomplete, duplicated, outdated, or unauthorized information.

Prepare customized dispute letters using company-approved procedures and AI tools.

Create separate dispute letters for Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion.

Review all AI-generated letters for accuracy before submission.

Process monthly dispute rounds for assigned clients.

Compare updated reports with previous reports.

Track disputed accounts, submission dates, responses, results, and follow-up actions.

Update client records and dispute progress inside our systems.

Prepare CFPB complaint drafts when appropriate and approved by management.

Escalate complicated cases to management.

Conduct one live, one-hour dispute education training every week for DIY 850 Club members.

Answer dispute-related questions inside the 850 Club community.

Help members understand realistic timelines, possible outcomes, and next steps.

Send a daily or end-of-shift progress report.

Protect all client information and follow company privacy procedures.

Important Expectations



The specialist must:



Never guarantee deletions or credit-score increases.

Never dispute information simply because it is negative.

Only dispute information the client has identified or confirmed as potentially inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, duplicated, or unauthorized.

Never invent dispute reasons, facts, or supporting information.

Communicate professionally and avoid providing legal advice.

Complete work accurately and on time.

Be comfortable speaking and teaching during weekly virtual sessions.

Be available consistently during the required Central Time schedule.

Qualifications

Previous experience processing consumer credit disputes.

Strong knowledge of Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion credit reports.

Experience reviewing collections, charge-offs, late payments, inquiries, personal information, public records, and other derogatory accounts.

Familiarity with the Fair Credit Reporting Act, CFPB complaints, identity-theft disputes, and Metro 2 reporting is preferred.

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable conducting live virtual training.

Comfortable using ChatGPT or similar AI tools.

Experience with GoHighLevel, Skool, Trello, Lob, or credit-repair software is helpful but not required.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, webcam, microphone, and backup internet access.

Strong attention to detail and ability to protect confidential client information.



TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION, REPLY WITH SUBJECT LINE "I AM YOUR DISPUTE SPECIALIST" & Answer the following questions:

1. Do you speak strong english? (this role requires recorded zoom calls of dispute education to our clients) 

Include your resume or portfolio. 

2. How many years of credit-repair or credit-dispute experience do you have?

3. What experience do you have creating CFPB complaints?

4. What do you understand about the FCRA and Metro 2 reporting?

5. How would you respond to a member who asks, “Can you guarantee this account will be deleted?”

title: Customer Service & Social Media Admin Specialist
description:
1. ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Arc Group is a growing US media network looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Chat Support & Data Tracking Specialist to join our remote team in the Philippines.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact for our massive online audience. Your primary focus will be posting content, replying to incoming viewer messages, and tracking daily engagement data. This is a 100% inbound administrative and customer service role—there is zero sales or cold outreach involved.



2. WHY WORK WITH US?

100% Remote: Work entirely from home.

No Sales or Cold Calling: You only talk to viewers who are already messaging us.

Simple, Process-Driven Work: We provide all the message templates, step-by-step guidelines, and tracking formats.

Stable Income: A consistent 40-hour work week with dependable, weekly payouts.



3. DAY-TO-DAY DUTIES

Your daily shifts will revolve around four core tasks: replying to viewers, posting content, tracking data, and routing files.

Replying to Viewers (WhatsApp Chat): Manage a high volume of incoming messages and giveaway entries from our audience. You will use our pre-saved text templates to respond quickly, politely, and efficiently.

Posting Content & Statuses: Take ready-to-go videos and images from our media team, apply standard watermarks, and post them directly to our WhatsApp Status channels to keep our viewers engaged.

Tracking Viewer Data & Analytics: Monitor and log daily metrics—such as total status views, message response numbers, and audience engagement counts—into a simple tracking sheet.

Reviewing Viewer Submissions: Check incoming video clips and news tips sent in by live viewers. Text them back to confirm basic details, and route the approved files to our US-based editing team via Slack.

Shift Hand-Off Logs: Keep clean, accurate data notes for the next tea
mber so they know exactly which viewer conversations or tracking logs are currently pending.



4. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR (REQUIREMENTS)

Good Written English: Ability to text clearly, type quickly, and maintain a friendly, professional tone with our viewers.

Basic Administrative & Tech Skills: Comfortable using Google Chrome, Slack, spreadsheets (for basic data tracking), and simple tools for saving/uploading media.

Strong Attention to Detail: Ability to accurately copy/paste templates and log viewer numbers without skipping steps.

Reliable Home Setup: A quiet workspace with high-speed internet. You must have active backup power and internet solutions (like a power station, generator, or mobile data backup) to guarantee you stay online during your shift.

Shift Availability: Fixed 40 hours per week (5 days a week). You must be fully available for one of these permanent shifts:

Shift A: Sunday night to Friday morning (7:00 PM – 4:00 AM PH time)

Shift B: Monday morning to Friday afternoon (3:00 AM – 12:00 PM PH time)



5. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Hourly Rate: $4.00 – $6.00 USD per hour (Depending on your administrative and chat experience).

Guaranteed Hours: Fixed 40 hours per week on a consistent 5-day schedule.

Weekly Payments: Sent directly via Wise for the best exchange rates and zero delays.

Growth Opportunities: Long-term career stability and performance-based scaling as our viewer network grows.



6. HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please follow these steps exactly:

Begin your cover letter or application message with this exact phrase: "Arc Group Systems Success"

Reply to this post with a direct link to your updated resume.

Change your application subject line to this exact format: [Customer Service & Social Media Admin Specialist - Your Full Name]

title: PR Manager
description:
PR Manager



Do you love reaching out to publications and media to get mentions, stories, guest posts and other placements?



Do you want to help develop the brand and following for an innovative new home services solution that’s going to rock the US market?



Do you want to put together podcasts, webinars and in-person US events to raise the company’s visibility?



If this is you, we want to talk! Tempesta Media, a leader in the US residential home services marketing technology industry for the past 15 years, is launching a groundbreaking new AI-powered platform for homeowners and contractors. This is really cutting-edge stuff!



We’re seeking a talented PR Manager to build the company’s brand authority. This includes:

• Media list development and outreach

• Publication outreach and placement

• Website guest post outreach

• Podcast guest appearance booking

• Booking speaking opportunities for the company

• Awards applications and more.



This is a 100% remote position that will require some overlap with US hours – Chicago – Central Time (-06:00 GMT) for meetings, events, training, etc. The position is a part-time position that has the opportunity to grow into a full-time role. 



You must have a reliable home office setup:

• Computer with at least 8GB of RAM (16GB+ preferred)

• High-resolution camera and noise-canceling microphone

• High-speed Internet access of at least 100MB down



The performance of this role will be measured on the following growth, engagement and bottom-funnel performance. The compensation will be a combination of salary and performance- and milestone-based bonuses.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• At least 2 years of B2B PR experience.

• At least 1 year of experience pitching journalists.

• At least 1 year of experience with securing speaking and guest appearance opportunities.

• US PR experience is required.

• US home services experience is a huge plus, but not required.

• A track record of quantifiable results.

• Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment in a small company.



HOW TO APPLY

The application process is straightforward. Follow these exact steps. If you do not, your application will automatically be rejected.

1. Send your resume.

2. Send us a link to your best PR placement success. Explain why it was so great. Explain how you achieved it. Cover the performance metrics – likes, reposts, engagement, leads, sales, etc. 

3. Include links to your social media profiles (let’s see how well you promote yourself)

4. Create a short, 60-second introduction video. Include the following:

• Who you are

• What do you know about Tempesta Media

• How you can make an impact in this role in the first 90 days

• Include your resume and salary requirements.



That’s it! We’ll review your information and get back to you within 2 business days.



NOTE: We will disregard incomplete applications missing all 4 components.



If we think you're a good fit, we’ll invite you to a Zoom video interview. Finalists will be offered a paid pilot, during which you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your talent

title: Asset Dispatch Specialist (Direct Experience Only)
description:
AJG Transport is a performance driven, asset based transportation company operating a growing fleet anchored in dedicated freight. We are looking for an Asset Dispatch Specialist that will serve as the driver’s first point of contact and will play a critical role in keeping our trucks, drivers, and freight moving efficiently.



About the Role

You will act as the central link between drivers and the operations team. You will manage day-to-day driver needs while building and adjusting daily dispatch schedules to prevent trucks from sitting idle and loads from running late. When a driver encounters an issue, you are the person they contact. When schedules, equipment, freight requirements, or Hours of Service limitations change, you are responsible for coordinating the solution.



Success in this role requires consistent execution, urgency, accountability, and clear communication. Drivers must remain supported, schedules must stay organized, equipment must remain productive, and operational issues must be resolved before they escalate.



Why This Role Matters

This is not a call center dispatch seat. This is driver centric fleet operations. You are the face of the company to our drivers and the engine of our daily execution. If your communication is slow, equipment sits and drivers get frustrated. If you manage and schedule with discipline and urgency, drivers stay, trucks run, and freight moves on time.



What You’ll Be Doing



Driver Management (first point of contact)

• Be the primary daily contact for an assigned group of drivers, the person they trust and call first.

• Own driver issues day to day: schedule questions, equipment, routing, pay questions routed correctly, and general support.

• Build relationships that keep drivers satisfied, informed, and retained. A driver who feels managed and supported stays.



Driver Scheduling & Dispatch

• Build and manage the daily driver schedule across local, regional, and dedicated lane assignments.

• Assign loads and coordinate trucks with precision and urgency, the right driver on the right run and on time.

• Adjust the schedule in real time as freight, HOS, and equipment realities change.



Execution & Uptime

• Keep trucks moving, eliminate idle time, cover every scheduled run, and close gaps before they cost us.

• Track equipment and trailer positioning; coordinate rotation so assets are where they need to be.



Compliance Support

• Ensure daily check-in protocols, ELD readiness, and routing instructions are followed.

• Keep drivers on the right side of HOS and DOT requirements.



Risk Mitigation

• Proactively spot and solve issues before they escalate such as HOS conflicts, misrouted trucks, idle equipment, and coverage gaps.



Collaborative Execution

• Work alongside leadership, recruiting, and the brokerage/ops team to cover shifts and resolve issues in real time.



Operational Logging

• Maintain shift-level documentation, driver notes, trailer counts, and escalation logs for senior review.



What You'll Be Measured On

• Driver satisfaction and retention within your assigned group

• On-time dispatch and schedule adherence

• Tractor and trailer uptime; reduction of idle-asset time

• Response time to driver issues and operational i

• Communication clarity and escalation speed

• Adherence to SOPs, protocols, and dispatch audit standards



Qualifications

• 2+ years in asset-based dispatch, driver management, fleet coordination, or driver scheduling

• Experience with ELD platforms and routing/dispatch software

• Strong relationship skills to ensure drivers respect you and want to work with you

• Clear and assertive communicator who stays calm and decisive under pressure

• Comfortable in a live and fast-moving operational setting

• Schedule flexibility, including weekend and high volume window availability

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct Hire to US Company

• Full Time Role

• Permanent Work From Home

• Current Shift Need: To be confirmed

• Zoom presence (with camera open) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and payroll

• Shifts may adjust based on operational demand



If you thrive in fast moving transportation operations, understand the importance of real-time coordination, and can execute with precision under pressure, we want to hear from you.

*****************************************



OVERVIEW

We are a U.S.-based private real estate lending company (short-term / hard-money loans). We are hiring a Loan Processor to manage borrower documents, keep loan files organized, coordinate closings, and help service active loans. You keep files complete, organized, and moving to closing — and keep funded loans on track afterward.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



File processing (pre-close)



- Collect and track all borrower documents; follow up on anything missing

- Maintain clean, organized digital loan files

- Keep loan pipeline stages updated in our systems

- Coordinate with borrowers, title companies, insurance, attorneys, brokers, and our underwriter

- Follow up on and help clear underwriting conditions prior to funding

- Track closing deadlines and payoff timelines

- Ensure loan files are complete prior to funding

- Coordinate signatures, closing scheduling, and funding



Active loan servicing (post-close)



- Administer construction/rehab draws (review expense lists and progress photos, coordinate disbursement)

- Follow up with borrowers on project progress and log a short monthly status note per active loan

- Keep active-loan files and pipeline current

- Flag issues early (late payments, delinquency, scope changes, insurance lapses)

- Provide weekly loan status updates



IDEAL CANDIDATE



- Experience with U.S. real estate loan processing or mortgage processing

- Hands-on experience using a loan management / mortgage software system

- Clear, confident spoken English — you will speak with U.S. borrowers and title companies by phone

- Comfortable following structured processes and checklists

- Organized and deadline-driven; able to juggle multiple active files

- Comfortable learning new software quickly



Bonus:



- Experience with private lenders or short-term real estate loans

- Experience using CRM or pipeline-management tools



SCHEDULE



- Remote

- Part-time to start (about 5–6 hours per week) on a standby basis, growing into a full-time role as loan volume increases

- Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. business hours



COMPENSATION



- Flat monthly compensation, part-time / on-standby to start, with a clear path to full-time as volume grows

- Include your expected monthly rate in your application



*** HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY ***

Start your application with: Loan Ops Ready

Then record ONE short Loom video (2–3 minutes) that includes BOTH of these:



Borrower call role-play: Imagine I am a borrower calling you. My rehab draw has not funded yet, and your file notes show I sent my expense list but no progress photos. Respond to me the way you would on a real phone call.

Real file walk-through: Tell me about one real loan file you processed from start to closing — what you chased, what almost delayed it, and how you handled it.



Applications without the video, or that do not start with "Loan Ops Ready," will not be reviewed.

title: HIRING: Full-Time Video Editor for a 7-Figure Supplement Brand
description:
We are a fast-growing DTC health supplement brand currently scaling toward $30K revenue days.

Most videos will be between 30 and 120 seconds and may include UGC, VSLs, advertorial-style content, AI-generated visuals, voiceovers, b-roll, and direct-response storytelling.



This is a long-term, fully remote position with a fixed salary of $1,000 USD per month, plus a highly attractive performance-based bonus structure.



What You’ll Do



* Edit high-converting video ads for Meta and Google

* Create videos between 30 and 120 seconds

* Develop strong hooks, pacing, captions, transitions, and visual patterns

* Use tools such as HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana, and Veo 3

* Work closely with our Creative Manager, Creative Strategists, and other Video Editors

* Source relevant raw footage, b-roll, visuals, and voiceovers

* Test new formats, trends, angles, and storytelling structures

* Deliver approximately 15 new ad concepts per week

* Iterate quickly on winning creatives to produce new variations



What We’re Looking For



* Experience editing performance-driven Meta ads

* A strong portfolio of UGC, short-form, VSL, or direct-response video ads

* A clear understanding of hooks, consumer psychology, pacing, and storytelling

* The ability to identify why an ad is likely to convert

* Experience working with performance metrics and creative testing

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable communication and the ability to meet deadlines

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a high creative output

* Willingness to test, learn, receive feedback, and iterate quickly

* A long-term mindset and genuine motivation to grow with the company



What You’ll Get



* Fixed salary of $1,000 USD per month

* A highly attractive performance-based bonus structure

* Significant earning potential when your creatives perform

* A fully remote, long-term position

* Direct collaboration with experienced editors, strategists, and the founder

* Clear guidance and feedback from a dedicated Creative Manager

* Access to performance data so you can understand which creatives are winning

* Opportunities to develop your direct-response and performance-marketing skills

* Salary and responsibility growth based on performance



How to Apply

1. A link to your portfolio

2. Examples of performance ads you have edited

We’re a small team that genuinely enjoys working together. We believe in clear communication, kindness, accountability, and operating with good intentions. We’re not looking for someone to simply complete tasks, we’re looking for the right person to become part of our team.



We handle the strategy, content planning, shot lists, copywriting, and client communication. Your role is to take those pieces and bring them to life through beautiful, polished content.



What You’ll Be Doing



• Edit short-form videos and reels using footage we provide

• Create Canva graphics and carousel posts using our brand assets and prepared copy

• Schedule and publish approved content using Metricool

• Follow our content calendar and creative briefs so you always know what’s coming next



What You Won’t Need To Do



• Come up with marketing strategies

• Write captions from scratch

• Communicate directly with clients

• Chase approvals or manage projects



Our goal is to let you focus on what you do best: creating high-quality content.



The Kind of Person We’re Looking For



We’re much more interested in finding the right person than checking every box on a résumé.



Ideally, you are someone who:



• Communicates openly and responds in a timely manner

• Is dependable and takes pride in doing great work

• Is flexible and comfortable working in a growing business where priorities occasionally shift

• Has a positive attitude and approaches challenges with good intentions

• Enjoys learning and improving over time

• Appreciates constructive feedback and collaboration



Our Style



Our brands are elegant, warm, and story-driven.



Think destination weddings, luxury travel, boutique resorts, and authentic experiences, not fast-paced viral edits or trend-based content.



If your editing style leans heavily toward TikTok trends, flashy transitions, or 
 content, this probably isn’t the right fit, and that’s completely okay. We’re simply looking for someone whose creative style aligns with the brands we serve.



Tools We Use



• Premiere Pro

• Canva

• Metricool

• Meta Business Suite

• Meta Ads Manager

• Claude



Hours & Growth



This position begins at approximately 15 hours per week.



We’re intentionally starting part-time because we want to build sustainably rather than overpromise. As our client base continues to grow, our hope is to grow this role into a full-time position for the right person.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow alongside us. We believe in creating stable, long-term opportunities and investing in people who are invested in the work.



Very Important To Get Hired

1. Work Samples: Include your work samples in the intro of your message and have it be relevant to our style

2. About You: Write us a little about you, what your strengths are and what you expect from this role.

3. Note: If you copy/paste generic a generic application without the 2 requirements above, you will not receive a reply from us

description:

mbers come in at least two days a week. This allows us to work from home and have flexibility, without altogether forgoing the excitement and 
nts of collaboration and inspiration you can only get from in-person time. Not to mention, we also genuinely enjoy spending time together and socializing.

mbers can grow and take risks. Each quarter we host events under our four cultural pillars; health & wellness, personal & professional development, social good, and social. We are proud to have been named:

San Diego Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in: 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, Inc 5000 Regionals Fastest Growing Companies in: 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, and 2026, San Diego Business Journal’s Fastest Growing Private Companies list in 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, and 2024, Inc Best Workplaces list in: 2024 and 2025, and Inc. 5000 for the last 6 years (
)!



If you work at Wonderist, you likely enjoy a challenge, appreciate autonomy, actually care about clients, and are looking for a team that you can enjoy being part of.



Job Description

The Accounts Payable Associate is responsible for managing the end-to-end payables process at Wonderist Agency across both operating entities. This includes processing vendor invoices, reconciling statements, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining accurate financial records. This role works closely with the accounting team and executive suite and reports directly to Finance Operations Manager.



Key Responsibilities

Weekly

Review and process incoming vendor invoices across both entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing)

Match invoices to purchase orders or approvals and route for sign-off as needed

Respond to vendor inquiries regarding payment status within 24 hours

Log all payables in accounting software and ensure coding accuracy by department and entity

Flag any discrepancies, duplicate charges, or overbilling for resolution

Review and process approved employee expense reimbursements, ensuring proper coding and timely payment

Monitor and reconcile Rippling Spend corporate card transactions against receipts and coding by department and entity

Review and process contractor invoices, including 1099-eligible payments submitted via Rippling or directly by contractors

Attend weekly finance check-in with leadership; come prepared with a current AP snapshot including aged items, open disputes, and any items requiring a decision or escalation



Monthly

Reconcile vendor statements against internal records and resolve any variances

Prepare a monthly AP aging report

Process approved payment runs and confirm remittance details with vendors

Support month-end close by providing complete and accurate AP data

Maintain organized digital records of all invoices, approvals, and payment confirmations

Reconcile Rippling Spend corporate card statements against internal records and resolve any variances



Quarterly/As Needed

Assist with audit preparation by compiling AP documentation as requested

Identify opportunities to streamline AP workflows or improve vendor billing accuracy

Support annual 1099 preparation by maintaining accurate vendor payment records throughout the year

Participate in process improvement initiatives related to finance operations

Collect and maintain W-9s for all new vendors and contractors at time of onboarding; maintain accurate vendor master file to support 1099 preparation

Support annual 1099 preparation for all eligible vendors and contractors, including payments processed via Rippling and direct invoice



Performance Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

Invoice processing accuracy (target: 99%+)

On-time payment execution with no missed due dates

AP aging report delivery on schedule each month

Vendor dispute resolution time

Quality and completeness of records for month-end close



Essential Functions: What You’ll Do

Invoice Processing and Payment Execution: Review, code, and process vendor invoices with accuracy and urgency. Ensure all invoices are matched to proper approvals before payment. Execute payment runs on schedule and confirm remittance with vendors as appropriate.

Vendor Relationship Management: Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for vendor billing inquiries. Maintain professional and responsive communication to protect vendor relationships while advocating for Wonderist's financial interests when discrepancies arise.

Discrepancy Resolution: Identify and investigate billing errors, duplicate charges, and overbilling situations. Document disputes clearly, communicate with vendors to reach resolution, and ensure credits or corrections are reflected accurately in the system.

Record Keeping and Reporting: Maintain complete and organized AP records in the accounting system. Produce monthly aging reports and provide data to support month-end close, audits, and leadership reporting as needed.

Cross-Entity Coordination: Manage payables across both operating entities (Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing), applying accurate entity coding and maintaining clear separation of records.

Rippling Spend and Expense Management: Reconcile corporate card transactions in Rippling Spend and process employee reimbursement requests. Ensure all card activity is coded accurately by department and entity and that receipts and approvals are documented.

Inter-Entity Transactions: Support accurate coding and reconciliation of any shared costs or allocated expenses across Wonderist Agency and Nomos Marketing, maintaining clear separation of records between entities.



Core Competencies: What you’ll bring to the role

Attention to Detail: You catch errors before they become problems. You verify totals, check coding, and review statements line by line. Nothing gets processed without confirmation.

Integrity: You handle sensitive financial information with discretion and operate with a high standard of accuracy and honesty.

Organization and Follow-Through: You manage a high volume of invoices and vendor communications without letting anything fall through the cracks. You maintain clear records and follow up proactively.

Communication and Professionalism: You correspond clearly and professionally with vendors and internal tea
mbers. You escalate issues with the right information and context so they can be resolved quickly.

Systems Proficiency: You are comfortable working in accounting software and picking up new tools. Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms is essential. Experience with Rippling Spend, 
, or similar platforms is a plus



Must-Have Qualifications

2+ years of accounts payable or bookkeeping experience

Proficiency with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar

Strong command of written English for vendor and internal communication

High attention to detail and comfort working with high-volume invoice environments

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with minimal supervision

Reliable internet connection and ability to work during Pacific Time business hours (partial overlap required)

Payment execution authority will be granted by leadership up to an approved threshold; comfort initiating and confirming payment runs within those parameters is required



Bonus Points for Applicants With…

(if you don’t have these but are organized and want to learn, we want to hear from you!)

Experience supporting multi-entity accounting environments

Familiarity with Rippling, Ramp, 
, or similar platforms

Background in agency, marketing, or professional services environments

Experience with 1099 preparation and vendor compliance



This is a Full-Time Salaried position. This role is structured as an EOR agreement with Rippling EOR and Wonderist Agency.

title: Lead Platform Engineer — Internal Operations Platform
description:
Eagle Production Co. | Wall Township, NJ (Hybrid or Remote for the right candidate) | Full-Time



About Eagle Production Co.

Eagle Production Co. is a nationwide AV equipment rental and production company based in New Jersey, running for over a decade. 



We rent and support audio, video, lighting, rigging, and power equipment for events across the country — from corporate premieres to touring productions.



Over the past year we’ve built something most companies our size don’t have: a full custom operations platform that runs the business — CRM, quoting, invoicing, payments, inventory availability, COI compliance, crew staffing, payroll support, fleet logistics, and customer/freelancer/driver portals. It was built fast using AI-assisted development (Lovable + Supabase), it’s live, it processes real money, and it works.

Now it needs an owner.



The Role

You will take over our platform as its dedicated engineer and technical owner. This is not a greenfield job and it’s not maintenance-only — it’s both harder and more interesting than either. You’ll inherit a large, live, AI-built codebase (~700 files, 150+ Supabase edge functions, 100+ database tables) and be responsible for three things:

 1. Keep it stable. New features have historically broken existing ones. You’ll change that — with tests around the money logic, disciplined releases, and real code review of every change, whether written by you or by AI tools.

 2. Keep it moving. The feature roadmap doesn’t stop. You’ll ship new functionality weekly, working directly with the CEO, using AI-assisted development where it’s fast and hand-written code where it’s right.

 3. Lead the migration off Flex Rental Solutions. Our inventory and operations still run partly on Flex. Over the next phases of our roadmap, this platform becomes the single hub for all company operations. You’ll architect and execute that migration — inventory, scanning, availability, warehouse workflows — without disrupting live operations.



What You’ll Do

 • Own the full stack: React/TypeScript frontend, Supabase backend (Postgres, RLS, edge functions, storage, cron), and the integrations around them (payment processing, QuickBooks, Gmail, Flex API, HubSpot, shipping/logistics APIs)

 • Stabilize and harden the existing codebase: eliminate duplicate logic, add a test suite around pricing, tax, invoicing, and payment flows, and close security gaps (RLS coverage, endpoint auth, storage policies)

 • Build new features end to end from CEO-defined requirements — often same-week turnaround

 • Plan and execute the Flex migration in phases: data model, sync strategy, cutover plan, rollback plan

 • Establish engineering discipline that survives AI-assisted development: GitHub-based workflow, pre-change audits, batched changes, post-change verification

 • Support the team using the platform daily (sales, warehouse, finance, HR) — triage issues fast, communicate clearly with non-technical users

 • Document what you build so the company is never dependent on any one tool or person

What We’re Looking For



Required:

 • 5+ years full-stack experience with deep React + TypeScript

 • Strong PostgreSQL, including Row-Level Security, and hands-on Supabase (or equivalent: Firebase + SQL, Hasura, etc.)

 • Experience owning a production system that handles real money — payments, invoicing, or e-commerce — and the paranoia that comes with it

 • Fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Copilot or similar) AND the judgment to review, constrain, and correct what those tools produce. We work AI-first here; we don’t work AI-blind.

 • Experience integrating third-party APIs (payment gateways, accounting,
)

 • Ability to work directly with a fast-moving, hands-on CEO: translate business requirements into working software quickly, push back when something is a bad idea, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain English

Strongly preferred:

 • Experience inheriting and stabilizing a large existing codebase (rescue/refactor work)

 • Migration experience: replacing a legacy system of record without downtime

 • Testing discipline: Vitest/Jest, and knowing what’s worth testing in a business app

Nice to have:

 • Rental, events, AV, or logistics industry exposure

 • Flex Rental Solutions, QuickBooks API, or Cardknox/payment gateway experience

 • Mobile/PWA experience (our warehouse runs barcode scanning on the platform)

What This Job Is Not

 • Not a junior role with AI doing the thinking — AI writes a lot of first drafts here; you own correctness

 • Not a big-company pace — decisions happen in hours, not sprints

 • Not siloed — you’ll talk to warehouse staff, salespeople, and the CEO in the same day

Compensation & Details

 • Salary: based on experience,

Sacred Flow Chiropractic & Wellness

Part-Time | Remote | $5–$6/hr to start



To be considered for this role, your application message must begin with the word FLOW and include a Loom video introducing yourself. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



About Us



Sacred Flow Chiropractic & Wellness is a growing chiropractic and wellness practice focused on nervous system health and patient transformation. We move fast, we care deeply about our patients, and we hold a high standard for everything that goes out the door. We are looking for someone who matches that energy.



About the Role



This is a **heavily administrative and operational role**. You will be the person keeping the practice organized, accurate, and running smoothly behind the scenes. A portion of this role includes patient-facing communication — scheduling, follow-ups, and
s — but this is **not** a clinical role and it is **not** a social media marketing role.



We need someone who reads instructions carefully, executes them precisely, checks the details before taking action, and communicates proactively. If you do something well, we will give you more. If you need things explained multiple times or prefer to do things your own way, this is not the right fit.



What You'll Be Doing



- Managing and organizing patient records and lists in our CRM (GoHighLevel / Practice Suite)

- Scheduling patient appointments and sending follow-up communications

- Drafting warm, accurate patient-facing
s and messages

- Keeping the back end of the practice organized — tagging, list management, data entry, and record accuracy

- Building and maintaining spreadsheets and trackers

- Scheduling social media posts (this is scheduling only — content is provided for you)

- Supporting day-to-day administrative tasks as they come up

- Sending a daily update of tasks completed



What We're Looking For



- Strong attention to detail — you verify information in the system before acting on anything

- Ability to follow instructions precisely the first time

- Fast turnaround — tasks should not sit for days

- Proactive communication — you don't wait to be chased down for updates

- Experience with GoHighLevel is a strong plus

- Excellent written English — patient communication must be warm and professional

- Consistent availability week to week — this role requires reliability, not availability that shifts with your schedule

- A self-starter who can work independently without constant direction



This Is NOT the Right Role If You...



- Need tasks repeated or re-explained before completing them

- Prefer to use your own judgment over following specific instructions

- Are looking for a social media marketing or content creation role

- Have inconsistent or limited availability

- Do not follow application instructions



Hours & Pay



- Part-time to start, with potential to grow

- $5–$6/hr depending on experience

- Weekly invoicing



How to Apply



Begin your message with the word **FLOW**. Include a **Loom video** (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself, walking us through your relevant experience, and telling us why you're a great fit for this specific role. Attach your **resume or CV** as well.



Applications without a Loom video and resume/CV will not be reviewed.



We are looking for someone who pays attention to details — your application is your first opportunity to show us that.

title: Virtual Assistant / Appointment Setter (Excellent English Speaking Skills Required)
description:
About Elite Gears Driving School



Elite Gears Driving School is a growing driving school dedicated to helping students become safe, confident drivers. As our business continues to expand, we're looking for a professional and friendly Virtual Assistant to handle inbound and outbound calls, assist customers, and manage lesson bookings.



This is a customer-facing role, so excellent spoken English is essential.



Position Overview



We are seeking a reliable Virtual Assistant who can confidently communicate with customers over the phone, answer enquiries, follow up with leads, and schedule driving lessons into our instructors' calendars.



You will often be the first point of contact for potential customers, so professionalism, friendliness, and strong communication skills are extremely important.



Responsibilities



* Answer inbound customer calls

* Make outbound calls to leads and existing customers

* Book driving lessons into instructors' schedules

* Respond to customer enquiries professionally

* Follow up on missed calls and website enquiries

* Confirm upcoming appointments

* Update customer records and booking information

* Communicate with instructors regarding schedules and availability

* Provide excellent customer service at all times



Requirements



Essential

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear, neutral English accent that is easy for UK and US customers to understand

* Previous experience in customer service, appointment setting, virtual assistance, or call handling

* Professional phone manner

* Strong organisational skills

* Ability to multitask and manage schedules accurately

* Reliable internet connection

* Quiet working environment

* High-quality headset and microphone



Preferred

* Experience using CRM systems

* Experience with appointment booking software

* Experience working with UK or US customers

* Sales or lead follow-up experience

* Driving school, education, or service-based business experience



What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is:



* Friendly and confident on the phone

* Professional and dependable

* Highly organised

* Comfortable speaking with customers throughout the day

* Able to build rapport quickly

* Detail-oriented when managing schedules and bookings



Compensation



Competitive hourly rate based on experience and communication skills.



Opportunities for pay increases and additional responsibilities are available for high-performing tea
mbers.



Application Instructions



To apply, please send:



1. Your resume

2. A short voice recording (1-2 minutes) introducing yourself in English

3. Any previous customer service or appointment-setting experience

4. Your expected hourly rate



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable to fulfill this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person who contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Experienced Video Editor – Long-Form YouTube Content

• Organize footage, project files, audio, graphics, and other editing assets

• Troubleshoot rendering, missing media, project file, and export issues

• Strong storytelling, pacing, and visual communication skills

• Strong understanding of video codecs, compression, bitrate, rendering, and export settings

• Experience with proxy workflows, color correction, audio editing, and motion graphics

• Ability to independently develop creative editing ideas

• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistent quality

• Experience reviewing or mentoring junior video editors is preferred

• Comfortable working during Sydney, Australia business hours

• Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment



Technical Requirements

• Windows 11 or macOS 13 or newer

• At least 8 GB of RAM, preferably 16 GB or more

• At least 256 GB of available storage

• Reliable computer capable of editing and rendering long-form videos

• Minimum internet speed of 50 Mbps

• HD webcam

• Reliable headset

• Quiet and professional remote workspace



Compensation

• Competitive salary

• 13th Month Pay

• Annual Base Salary Increases

• Monthly performance bonuses



What We’re Looking For:

• Have a strong creative eye and understand how to keep viewers engaged

• Take ownership of their work from project setup to final delivery

• Can balance editing speed with quality and accuracy

• Communicate clearly and collaborate well with remote teams

• Can troubleshoot technical issues without relying heavily on others

• Accept feedback professionally and continuously improve their work

• Can guide and support less-experienced editors when needed



How to Apply

• Please make sure to include your updated resume, portfolio, and samples of long-form YouTube videos you edited

title: Pipeline Manager / Sales Development Representative (Remote)
description:
Compensation



Base Salary: USD $200–$300 per month



In addition to your monthly base salary, you'll have the opportunity to earn performance-based commissions tied directly to the opportunities you generate.



Commission Structure

USD $50 for every qualified prospect who attends a completed Local Marketing Analysis (Audit) that you scheduled and qualified.

USD $200 for every new client who signs an agreement and completes their initial payment from an opportunity you generated.



Our commission structure rewards quality over quantity. The better you qualify prospects and the more Audits that convert into clients, the more you earn.

__________________________________________________________________

About the Role



We're looking for a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Pipeline Manager / SDR to own our sales pipeline from the first contact through the Discovery process.



Your primary responsibility is to generate qualified opportunities and keep our sales calendar full.



You create the opportunities.



Our Sales Consultant closes them.



Together, you'll help drive the company's growth.

__________________________________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

1. Manage All New Inbound Leads



Every new lead generated through our marketing channels will be assigned to you.



Lead sources include:



Website inquiries

Google Ads


Phone calls

Other inbound marketing channels



Your responsibilities include:



Respond promptly to every new lead.

Contact prospects requesting information.

Schedule and conduct Discovery Calls (approximately 15–20 minutes).

Learn about each prospect's business, goals, and current marketing efforts.

Determine whether they are qualified for our services.

Schedule qualified prospects for a Local Marketing Analysis (Audit) with our Sales Consultant.

Document disqualified leads and maintain appropriate follow-up.



Goal: Every qualified Discovery Call should end with a scheduled Audit.



2. Reactivate Existing Opportunities



Work our CRM daily to identify and re-engage prospects who have previously interacted with our company.



Priority includes:



Audit No-Shows

Discovery No-Shows

Previous Audits that did not close

Existing CRM opportunities

Older inbound leads



Our CRM contains more than 25,000 contacts, making it one of our most valuable assets.



3. Conduct Discovery Calls



Discovery Calls should:



Build rapport

Learn about the business

Understand goals and challenges

Review current marketing efforts

Determine if the prospect is a qualified fit



If qualified, schedule a Local Marketing Analysis before ending the call.



4. Reduce No-Shows



Help maximize attendance by confirming:



Discovery Calls

Local Marketing Analyses (Audits)



Use phone calls, text messages, and
 reminders when appropriate.



5. CRM Management



Maintain accurate records for every opportunity, including:



Detailed notes

Current pipeline stage

Next follow-up date

Next action item



Every opportunity should have a clear follow-up plan.



6. Follow-Up



Maintain consistent communication with:



New leads

Existing opportunities

Previous prospects

Long-term nurture leads



Our CRM is an active sales tool—not just a database.

__________________________________________________________________

Weekly Reporting



Every Friday, submit a report including:



Unique Calls Attempted

Unique Conversations

Discovery Calls Completed

Qualified Discoveries

Local Marketing Analyses Scheduled

Audit Attendance Rate

New Clients Closed

New Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) Generated

__________________________________________________________________

Monthly Success Goals

Keep the Sales Consultant's Audit calendar consistently full.

Increase Discovery and Audit attendance rates.

Reactivate dormant CRM opportunities.

Help achieve company goals of:

20+ completed Local Marketing Analyses

6–8 new clients

Positive Net New MRR

__________________________________________________________________



What We're Looking For

Excellent spoken and written English.

Confident and professional on the phone.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Experience with CRM systems (GoHighLevel experience is a plus).

Comfortable making outbound calls and handling inbound leads.

Self-motivated, dependable, and results-oriented.

Sales, appointment setting, or SDR experience is preferred.

A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself, your sales or appointment-setting experience, and why you'd be a great fit for this role.

Most client funding comes from commercial insurance. However, some clients may be funded through school districts, state agencies, private pay arrangements, or other contracted funding sources. This role is responsible for making sure each funding source is billed accurately, invoices and claims are submitted on time, and payments are collected and properly recorded.



This position is critical to maintaining financial health and preventing administrative issues from disrupting client care. The ideal candidate has strong behavioral health billing experience, is highly organized and proactive, and can independently manage accounts from initial authorization or funding verification through final payment.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Insurance Billing and Claims Management



* Submit accurate and timely insurance claims for RTC, PHP, and IOP services

* Ensure proper coding, modifiers, rates, and documentation alignment before submission

* Monitor claim status and proactively resolve denials, rejections, and underpayments

* Track claims through full payment resolution

* Maintain clean and organized billing records for all clients



### School District, State, and Private Pay Billing



* Prepare and submit invoices to school districts, state agencies, families, and other funding partners

* Confirm billing rates, service dates, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documentation

* Track invoices from submission through payment

* Follow up on overdue balances and resolve missing documentation or payment issues

* Maintain clear records of payer requirements, billing contacts, and payment terms



### Utilization Review and Authorizations



* Obtain and manage pre-authorizations for covered services

* Submit concurrent and continued-stay reviews to insurance companies

* Track authorization dates, units, service limits, and expiration timelines

* Coordinate with clinical staff to obtain necessary documentation

* Help verify that services remain aligned with payer and funding requirements



### Accounts Receivable Management



* Perform ongoing follow-up with insurance companies and other funding sources

* Identify and escalate billing issues early to prevent aging balances

* Maintain low accounts receivable aging through proactive management

* Reconcile payments, adjustments, EOBs, remittance notices, and outstanding balances

* Ensure all accounts have a clear next action and expected payment timeline



### Insurance Paneling and Credentialing Support



* Assist with insurance paneling applications and renewals

* Maintain credentialing records and documentation

* Track panel status and help ensure continuity of network participation



### Coordination, Tracking, and Communication



* Communicate clearly with leadership regarding billing status, collection risks, and unresolved issues

* Collaborate with clinical and operational staff to ensure documentation supports billing requirements

* Maintain accurate tracking by client, payer, funding source, invoice, claim, and payment status

* Provide regular reporting on billing performance, outstanding balances, aging, denials, and risks



## Expected Scope



* Approximately 20 active clients

* Primarily commercial insurance billing

* Additional billing to school districts, state agencies, private pay families, and other funding sources

* Primarily RTC, with some PHP and IOP services

* Ongoing monthly billing, follow-up, utilization management, invoicing, and collections

* Flexible hours, with consistent weekly engagement required



## Required Qualifications



* Minimum two years of behavioral health billing or revenue cycle experience

* RTC billing experience strongly preferred

* Proven experience working with commercial insurance providers

* Strong experience with pre-authorizations, utilization review, and denial resolution

* Experience managing claims or invoices through the full lifecycle, from submission through payment

* Experience managing accounts receivable and following up on aging balances



## Technical Skills



* Strong understanding of behavioral health billing workflows

* Knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, revenue codes, modifiers, and payer-specific billing requirements

* Familiarity with insurance portals, clearinghouses, claims systems, and invoicing tools

* Ability to manage multiple funding structures, rates, contracts, and payment terms

* Strong organizational, reconciliation, and tracking skills



## Personal Attributes



* Highly detail-oriented

* Proactive and responsive

* Strong ownership mentality

* Persistent and professional in payment follow-up

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision

* Clear and professional communicator



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience billing school districts, state agencies, Medicaid programs, or government contracts

* Experience with private pay invoicing and collections

* Experience billing for transitional living or outpatient behavioral health programs

* Experience with credentialing and insurance paneling

* Familiarity with the Utah behavioral health funding and insurance landscape

* Experience working in contract or outsourced billing roles



## Position Details



* Contract position (1099)

* Remote work

* Flexible hours



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* Claims and invoices submitted accurately and on time

* Authorizations obtained without interruption to care

* Minimal claim denials and fast resolution when denials occur

* School district, state, and private pay invoices collected within agreed payment terms

* Low accounts receivable aging across all funding sources

* Every outstanding balance has a documented next action

* Leadership has clear visibility into billing, collections, and payment risks at all times

title: Full-Time Remote Sales & Customer Success Manager
description:
About BetterYOU Fitness Centre



BetterYOU Fitness Centre is a growing 24/7 gym located in Pakenham, Victoria, Australia.



We are looking for a confident, organised and results-driven person to take full ownership of our leads, outbound calls and member retention systems.



This is not a general virtual assistant position.



Your main responsibility will be to contact new leads quickly, book appointments, follow up consistently and help retain existing gy
mbers.



Your Primary Responsibilities



New Lead Management-

Monitor incoming leads throughout your shift

Call every new lead within five minutes

Contact leads by phone, SMS and

Qualify leads and book gym tours or appointments

Follow up leads consistently until they book, join or clearly decline

Follow up missed calls, no-shows and cancelled appointments

Reactivate old leads

Keep all lead information, notes and statuses updated

Ensure no lead is forgotten or left without follow-up



Membership Renewals-

Contact members approaching the end of their membership

Encourage members to renew before their membership expires

Follow up members who have not yet made a renewal decision

Update all outcomes and notes accurately



Outstanding Payments-

Contact members with failed payments or outstanding balances

Help members arrange payment

Follow up until the payment is resolved

Escalate disputes or difficult cases to management



Member Retention and Reactivation-

Contact members who have stopped attending the gym

Contact members who may be at risk of cancelling

Find out why members have become inactive

Encourage inactive members to return

Follow up members who have expressed concerns or requested cancellation

Identify problems early and escalate them when required

Conduct scheduled member check-in calls



Lead and Marketing Administration-

Manage the gym’s lead pipeline

Track where leads are coming from

Monitor lead response times and follow-up activity

Help test different call times and follow-up methods

Report common objections and lead quality

Provide daily and weekly performance reports

Ensure lead forms, contact lists and follow-up systems are working correctly



Any other smaller admin jobs needed



Performance Expectations

You will be measured on:



Lead response time

Percentage of leads called within five minutes

Number of outbound calls completed

Contact rate

Appointments booked

Appointment attendance rate

Lead-to-member conversion rate

Membership renewals

Outstanding payments recovered

Inactive members reactivated

Cancellations prevented

Accuracy of notes and reporting



Requirements-

Excellent spoken and written English

Clear, confident and natural phone communication

Previous experience in sales, appointment setting, customer service, collections or retention

Comfortable making outbound calls every day

Able to follow scripts without sounding robotic

Strong organisation and follow-up skills

Reliable high-speed internet connection

Quiet and professional home working environment

Reliable computer and quality headset

Able to work independently without constant supervision

Comfortable being measured against clear KPIs

Strong attention to detail

Available Monday to Friday during Melbourne, Australia working hours

No conflicting job or commitments during rostered hours



Ideal Candidate-

You will be a strong fit if you:



Take ownership of your responsibilities

Act quickly when a new lead arrives

Are persistent without being pushy

Can handle rejection professionally

Enjoy speaking with customers and solving problems

Follow systems accurately

Do not need to be constantly reminded

Are motivated by targets and measurable results

Can build rapport while moving conversations toward an outcome



Experience working with gyms, fitness businesses, membership businesses or Australian customers will be highly regarded.



Training-

You will receive training on:



BetterYOU Fitness Centre memberships and services

Lead follow-up systems

Call scripts

Objection handling

Appointment booking

Membership renewals

Retention conversations

Outstanding payment follow-up

CRM and reporting requirements



Calls will be recorded and reviewed for training, coaching and quality control.



Employment Details

Full-time position

40 hours per week

Monday to Friday

9:00 AM–6:00 P
lbourne, Australia time

One-hour unpaid meal break

AUD$7 per hour during the initial 30-day probation period

Increase to AUD$10 per hour after probation based on reliability, communication, accuracy and performance

Long-term opportunity for the right person

Pay rises will be given to the correct person with proven work and results





How to Apply-

Please include:



The word BETTERYOU at the beginning of your application

A short introduction about yourself

Details of your sales, appointment-setting, outbound calling, retention or collections experience

A voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be suitable for this position

Your internet speed

A photo of your computer and headset setup

Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 P
lbourne time

Details of any other jobs or ongoing work commitments



Please do not apply if you are uncomfortable making outbound calls, speaking with Australian customers or being accountable for performance targets.

title: Sales Operations & Outreach Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity

 

We're building a client acquisition operation. Right now, we need someone who can reach prospects, start conversations, and keep the pipeline flowing so I can focus on closing and serving clients.

 

You'll be the first point of contact. Your job is to generate qualified conversations and move them toward a call. You'll spend most of your time on outreach: finding people who fit what we're looking for, crafting personalized messages, and following up to book calls. You'll track everything that happens so we know what's working.

 

As the business grows, your responsibilities will expand based on what makes sense operationally. This could mean deeper sales operations work, team management, or other areas. We'll build it together as we go.

 

This is structured work with clear metrics and a clear growth path.

 

---

 

Who We're Looking For

 

You have experience starting conversations with prospects or customers in a sales or marketing context. This could be cold outreach, prospecting, inside sales,
 campaigns, customer follow-up, or similar work. You understand how conversations move forward.

 

You're coachable and willing to learn. You don't need to be perfect at sales already. If you have a foundation and you're willing to learn, we'll develop your skills from there.

 

You're organized. You can manage multiple conversations simultaneously and follow up consistently without dropping balls.

 

You communicate clearly. You can write professional, personalized messages. You understand how to reach someone in a way that gets a response.

 

You're adaptable. You're willing to learn new systems as the role grows. You're not looking for a rigid job description that never changes.

 

You're self directed. Given a process and clear expectations, you execute without needing constant supervision.

 

You're honest. If something isn't working, you say so. If you don't understand something, you ask.

 

---

 

How We Work Together

 

We're hiring for attitude and coachability. During weeks 1 to 2, you'll learn our outreach playbook with direct founder guidance. We have daily 30 minute check-ins where you'll get feedback, answers to your questions, and direction on what to focus on each day. Your job is to execute and learn. Our job is to make sure you have everything you need to succeed. By week 3, you'll be running outreach independently with confidence.

 

We value execution and honesty. You'll work directly with a founder who communicates clearly and invests in your growth.

 

---

 

What We Offer

 

Compensation and Structure:

- Trial period (Weeks 1 to 2): $200 per month, paid weekly, flexible part time hours

- Full time (Week 3 onward): $400 per month, paid weekly, 8 AM to 5 PM Pacific, Monday through Friday

- You're paid for all work accomplished during the trial period

 

Benefits:

- Paid time off and paid sick days

- 13th month bonus annually

- Performance bonuses tied to specific wins and KPI achievement

 

How the Trial Works:

During weeks 1 and 2, we'll evaluate whether your learning speed and execution style match what we need. You'll execute our outreach playbook and hit quality and consistency metrics. If you're a fit, we move to full time immediately. Full benefits and detailed compensation policies are provided at onboarding.

 

---

 

How to Apply

 

Include the word "Iron Man" in your subject line or in the first sentence of your message. This is required. Applications without "Iron Man" will be skipped.

 

We'll review applications on a rolling basis and reach out if there's a fit.

Contracting Support & Network Adequacy



- Monitor contracting pipelines, ensuring group contract addendums and provider agreements are executed correctly



- Support the operations team by gathering data and preparing applications to challenge commercial panel closures (network adequacy appeals)



- Regularly audit payer directories to ensure Josi Health providers are visible and active





Coordination & Compliance



- Monitor licensure and certification expiration dates (e.g., state medical licenses, DEA, malpractice) and send timely renewal alerts to providers



- Collaborate closely with recruiting and clinical teams to coordinate the onboarding schedule of incoming providers

- Provide clear, professional updates to providers on their credentialing status, making document retrieval as painless as possible

Must-Have



- 2+ years of healthcare experience specializing in provider credentialing, payer enrollment, or provider relations
