title: Part-Time SEO Backlink Outreach Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Position Overview

Today's Business (TB) is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency seeking a Part-Time SEO Backlink Outreach Coordinator to run ongoing, ethical white-hat link building campaigns for our client roster — including Amplifi (Braiden Shaw), Ammerländer, and our full portfolio of SEO clients.



This role is 100% focused on earning high-quality, credible, dofollow backlinks that genuinely improve each client's domain authority and organic visibility. You will identify relevant sites, vet them against real quality standards, pitch real placement opportunities, coordinate with our internal SEO/content team on the right target pages and anchor text, and manage every link from first outreach through to a confirmed, live placement. This is not a directory-submission or PBN/link-farm role — every link earned must come from a legitimate, editorially relevant, human-reviewed placement.

What "Ethical, White-Hat" Means for This Role

Only pursue placements on real, active, editorially-run websites with genuine audiences — no link farms, private blog networks (PBNs), link exchanges, or paid-link schemes disguised as editorial content

Prioritize dofollow links, but never misrepresent a paid or sponsored placement as organic/editorial

Target sites and pages that are topically relevant to the client's industry — a finance client gets finance/wealth placements, a food/CPG client gets food/recipe/retail placements, etc.

Respect every publisher's guidelines, disclosure requirements, and "no" — no repeated badgering after a decline

Never buy links from known link-selling networks or use automated/spam outreach tools that mass-blast irrelevant sites

Vetting a Site Before You Pitch It

"High quality" isn't a feeling — every prospect gets checked against real criteria before any outreach goes out:



Domain Rating (DR/DA): prioritize established, authoritative sites over brand-new or low-authority ones

Spam Score: avoid domains with high spam signals (thin content, unnatural link patterns, suspicious TLDs) — when in doubt, run it through Ahrefs/Moz before pitching

Real organic traffic: the site should have actual visitors, not just a DR number with no real audience behind it

Topical relevance: the site's content/audience should genuinely relate to the client's industry — a finance placement for Amplifi, a food/retail placement for Ammerländer, etc.

Real editorial site, not a link farm: confirm there's an actual publication with real authors, regular content, and a real audience — not a site that exists purely to sell links

Flag any borderline case to the SEO team in Slack rather than guessing



Core Responsibilities



Outreach Execution



Identify and qualify backlink opportunities daily across the assigned client roster, including:

"Best of" / roundup list inclusion (e.g., best cheese brands, best credit cards, best investing tools)

Guest post and expert-contributor pitches to relevant blogs and trade publications

HARO/journalist-request style expert-commentary opportunities

Industry and trade association outreach (e.g., professional/trade organizations relevant to the client's category)

Competitor backlink gap outreach (sites linking to competitors but not the client)

Broken-link and unlinked-brand-mention outreach (sites mentioning the brand/product without a working link)

Resource page and "recommended tools/reading" page outreach

Send personalized, non-templated-feeling outreach
s (using TB's approved templates as a starting framework, not a copy-paste script)

Track every prospect and every outreach touchpoint in 
 — no outreach happens outside the board



Coordination



Coordinate with the internal SEO/content team via Slack before finalizing any pitch to confirm:

Which specific client page(s) should receive the link

Approved anchor text for each placement (contextual, keyword-aligned, non-spammy)

Any pages that are off-limits or any anchor text to avoid

Flag any opportunity that requires client-specific context, budget approval (paid placements), or legal/compliance review before pursuing



Follow-Through & Verification



Follow up on outstanding pitches on a set cadence until a final yes/no

Once a placement is confirmed, verify the link goes live, confirm it is dofollow (unless otherwise agreed), confirm the anchor text and destination URL match what was approved, and screenshot/log proof

Flag any placement that goes live incorrectly (wrong anchor text, nofollow when dofollow was promised, wrong URL) for correction with the publisher



Reporting



Target baseline: 200–300 outreach pitches per week across the client roster (adjusted up/down by client priority and season) — this is the number the weekly report is measured against

Submit a weekly report covering, at minimum:

Total outreach sent (by client)

Total responses received / response rate

New placements confirmed and gone live that week (with URLs)

Pipeline status of everything still in follow-up

Any blockers or opportunities needing internal input

Tools You'll Use


 — primary system of record for all outreach, prospect status, and link tracking

Slack — daily coordination with the SEO/content team on target pages and anchor text

Gmail/Outreach
 — outreach and follow-up

Ahrefs — used by the team to identify/qualify high-authority prospects and to confirm domain rating and dofollow status of live links (training provided if you haven't used it)



Qualifications

Prior experience in SEO link building, digital PR, or outreach/business development (agency experience a plus)

Excellent written English — outreach
s represent real client brands to real publishers and journalists

Highly organized with proven ability to manage a high volume of ongoing outreach threads without letting things fall through the cracks

Comfortable working independently against a weekly cadence and reporting deadline

Familiarity with 
 and Slack preferred; willingness to learn Ahrefs basics required

Understanding of (or willingness to quickly learn) what makes a backlink high-quality vs. low-quality/spammy — domain authority, relevance, dofollow vs. nofollow, editorial context



Time Tracking

All work hours must be logged daily using 
 (or another team-approved time tracker) — clock in at shift start, clock out at shift end, no exceptions

Time logs are reviewed against weekly output (outreach volume, follow-ups, placements confirmed) — consistent hours with consistently low output will be addressed directly

title: Software Engineer (React Focused)
description:
Software Engineer (React Focused) 



About the Role:

We're looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who enjoys building products, solving complex technical challenges, and making a meaningful impact.



Our platform powers hundreds of websites, a custom CMS and CRM, AI-powered tools, search technology, home visualization software, and multiple consumer-facing applications. We're actively evolving our technology stack, modernizing existing systems, and building new products that leverage AI to improve both the customer and internal user experience.



While this role has a strong front-end emphasis, particularly with React and modern JavaScript, we're looking for an engineer who's comfortable contributing across the stack when needed. Our ideal candidate is someone who loves building software, takes ownership of their work, and enjoys solving problems wherever they exist.



This is not a greenfield project. You'll be joining an established engineering team and jumping into a mature platform with a large existing codebase. Success in this role requires the ability to quickly understand existing systems, work within established patterns, and confidently enhance and extend applications while helping us modernize them over time.



This is a long-term, full-time remote contractor position. You'll work directly with leadership and a small team of experienced engineers where your ideas and contributions will have an immediate impact.



What You'll Do:

- Build modern user interfaces using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript

- Build new features within our existing software platform

- Quickly learn and become productive within a large, established codebase

- Design and implement new product features from concept through deployment

- Develop reusable components and maintain scalable front-end architecture

- Work with PHP and Symfony to support backend development when needed

- Integrate REST APIs, third-party services, AI models, and automation tools

- Help modernize legacy applications while improving performance, stability, and maintainability

- Debug and resolve issues across front-end and back-end systems

- Optimize application performance, accessibility, and user experience

- Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision making

- Review code and contribute to engineering best practices

- Collaborate closely with leadership and other engineers to rapidly deliver high-value features



What We're Looking For (Required):

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Expert-level React experience

- Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills

- Experience building applications with Next.js

- Strong understanding of modern HTML5 and CSS3

- Experience with Tailwind CSS

- Solid PHP development experience

- Experience with Symfony or a similar MVC framework

- Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs

- Strong SQL and relational database experience

- Experience with Git and modern development workflows

- Experience understanding, debugging, and extending large existing codebases

- Ability to quickly become productive on an established software platform

- Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

- Ability to take ownership of projects from design through deployment

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills



Nice to Have:

- Experience integrating AI/LLMs into production applications

- Experience building AI-assisted workflows and automation tools

- Experience working with custom CMS or CRM platforms

- Experience modernizing legacy systems

- Docker and containerized development

- CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation

- AWS or other cloud platforms

- Elasticsearch or OpenSearch

- Experience optimizing Core Web Vitals and application performance

- Startup or small-team experience where wearing multiple hats is expected



What Success Looks Like:

- Shipping high-quality features that customers love

- Becoming productive quickly within our existing platform

- Building clean, maintainable, and scalable software

- Improving performance, reliability, and user experience across our applications

- Helping modernize existing systems while reducing technical debt

- Taking ownership of projects and delivering them with minimal supervision

- Bringing thoughtful ideas that improve both our products and our engineering processes



Why Join Us:

You'll be joining a small, highly collaborative engineering team where every developer has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. There are no layers of bureaucracy or endless meetings—just talented people working together to build products that people use every day.



You'll work on a diverse set of applications spanning consumer websites, business software, AI-powered tools, search technology, interactive product configurators, and internal business systems. No two weeks are exactly alike, and you'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies while helping shape the future direction of our platform.



We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out, isn't afraid to dive into an existing codebase, and takes pride in building software the right way. If you're excited about React, comfortable working across the stack, and enjoy solving real-world engineering challenges, we'd love to talk with you.



When Applying, Please include:

- Your resume

- GitHub profile (if available)

- Portfolio or examples of applications you've built

- A brief description of the projects you've worked on and your role in each



Application Instructions:

To help us identify candidates who pay attention to detail, please begin your application with the phrase:



"I build great software."



Also include:

- Your favorite React project and why

- The AI tools you regularly use during development (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.)

description:
We are SteadyAnswer, a US-based AI receptionist service built specifically 

for home service contractors — HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, and 

restoration companies. We help contractors capture the revenue they're 

losing to missed calls by answering their phones 24/7 with an AI 

receptionist that books jobs automatically.



We are looking for an experienced
 and Instagram Ads specialist 

to own our paid traffic from end to end — creative, copy, testing, 

optimization, and lead generation.



This role starts part-time. As we see results and the account grows, 

it will transition into a full-time position. We are not looking for 

someone to set up a campaign and disappear. We want a partner who grows 

with us and takes ownership of results.



---



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Write ad copy for cold-traffic and retargeting campaigns

- Develop creative concepts and direct video/image ad production

- Build and manage campaigns in Meta Ads Manager

- Run structured A/B tests across hooks, creative formats, and audiences

- Monitor cost-per-lead and optimize toward profitability

- Report weekly on what is working, what is not, and what you are 

  changing and why

- Scale winning campaigns as unit economics are proven



---



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You have at least 2 years of hands-on
 and Instagram Ads 

experience running campaigns that TARGET US-based local service business 

owners — home service contractors, trades, or similar B2B audiences. 

Not e-commerce. Not info products. Campaigns where the goal was to get 

a business owner to take action.



You can show us real results. We will ask for case studies or screenshots 

showing cost-per-lead from campaigns you personally managed. If you 

cannot show results, this is not the right role.



You think in terms of cost-per-lead and lead quality — not impressions, 

reach, or engagement. You understand that an ad campaign that generates 

100 leads at $5 each is worthless if none of them are qualified buyers.



You are a clear communicator who writes weekly updates in plain English — 

what the numbers were, what you tested, and what you are doing next.



---



WHAT THIS IS NOT



- This is not a setup-and-handoff project. We need ongoing management.

- This is not an agency role. We are hiring one dedicated person, not 

  a team that rotates our account.

- This is not for beginners who want to learn on our budget.



---



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, your application must include:



1. A brief description of 1-2
 Ads campaigns you personally 

   managed that targeted US local service or home service business 

   owners — what the business was, what you tested, and what results 

   you achieved.



2. At least one screenshot or case study showing actual cost-per-lead 

   or cost-per-acquisition from a campaign you ran.



3. Your monthly rate for ongoing campaign management (not including 

   ad spend).



Applications without results or examples will not be reviewed.

title: Weekend Virtual Assistant – Serviced Accommodation (Part Time)
description:
Hours: Saturday and Sunday, approx. 6–8 hours per day (UK daytime coverage)



Rate: $5-8



Start: As soon as possible



About Us



Arhouse manages 11 serviced accommodation and 2 HMO properties across London. Guests book through Airbnb, 
, VRBO and our direct site, all managed through Zeevou. We run a small, well-organised remote team and most things are documented in ClickUp, but this is still a work in progress, which is we’d love your help to complete.



The Role



You’ll be the first point of contact for guests at weekends. That means responding to enquiries,  messages and calls, handling check-in questions, resolving minor issues and escalating anything urgent. Weekends are our busiest time for arrivals, so calm, prompt and friendly communication matters.



Alongside guest support you’ll handle admin tasks including receipt collection, inbox management and support across our HMO portfolio. This role also acts as backup cover for our weekday VA, so over time you’ll be trained across the full operation.



We’re looking for someone who genuinely takes ownership. If you spot a better way of doing something, we want to hear it. If a guest has a problem, we want you to find a way to fix it rather than wait to be told.



Responsibilities



 • Respond to guest messages across all platforms via Hostaway within 5 minutes during working hours

 • Handle check-in and check-out queries, access instructions and general guest requests

 • Log and escalate maintenance or urgent issues following our escalation process

 • Coordinate with cleaners on same-day turnovers where needed

 • Respond to guest reviews using our templates

 • Collect and file receipts and invoices for our bookkeeping system (Dext)

 • Manage and organise the business inbox, flagging anything that needs the owner’s attention

 • Support admin tasks on our HMO portfolio (tenant queries, records, documentation)

 • Keep ClickUp updated with any issues, actions and handover notes for the weekday team

 • Suggest improvements to processes and templates where you see gaps

 • Break down recurring tasks into clear step-by-step SOPs in ClickUp so anyone on the team can follow them

 • Complete a short end-of-shift handover summary each day



What You Won’t Be Doing

 • Pricing (handled by PriceLabs)

 • Contacting landlords or suppliers directly

 • Bookkeeping or financial tasks except receipt filing



About You



 • Reliable above all. You show up every weekend, on time, without chasing

 • Proactive and resourceful. You try to solve problems before escalating and don’t wait to be told what to do

 • Genuine customer service attitude. You actually care about guests having a good stay

 • Excellent written English, warm but professional tone

 • Previous experience in short-term rental or hospitality guest communication (Zeevou, Airbnb or similar a strong plus)

 • Comfortable following documented processes, and keen to improve them when you spot a better way

 • Calm under pressure, especially with unhappy guests or last-minute problems

 • Organised and consistent with admin, filing and handover notes

 • Stable internet connection and consistent weekend availability



Nice to Have

 • Experience with ClickUp

 • Familiarity with London geography



What We Offer

 • Consistent weekend hours with long-term stability

 • Full training and clear documentation for every process

 • Scope to pick up extra hours covering holidays and, over time, a bigger role as the business grows

 • A direct, no-nonsense working relationship with clear expectations



How to Apply



Send a short message covering:

 1. Your experience with guest communication or hospitality

 2. An example of a time you fixed a problem or improved a process without being asked

 3. Your weekend availability (UK time)

 4. Your expected hourly rate

title: Long-Term Golf YouTube Editor | Premiere Pro 25.6.3 | Paid Per Video
description:
I edit for an established golf YouTube channel and I'm hiring one

editor to take over first-cut editing long term. The work is

steady and simple, but I'm strict about a few things, so please

read the whole post.



THE JOB

You get proxy footage (about a 5GB download per video) through

Google Drive. You build the story cut: clips in the right order,

dead space and bad takes cut out, best takes chosen. No music, no

titles, no graphics, no color, no export. I handle all After

Effects and final delivery. You send back the project file, so

there's no big upload on your end.



THE STYLE

Instructional golf for an older audience. Calm, clear, story

first. No flashy zooms, no sound effect spam, no hype editing.

If you can make a round of golf feel like a story, you're who I

want. Watch a video or two from the channel I edit for so you

know the finished product:





HARD REQUIREMENT

You must run Adobe Premiere Pro 25.6.3. I'm locked to this version

and cannot open projects saved in newer ones. Creative Cloud lets

you install it alongside whatever version you use now. If you

can't or won't run 25.6.3, please don't apply.



PAY

Flat rate per video, and I tell you the tier before you start so

you always know what you're getting:

- Easy (short video, light footage): $45

- Standard (typical video): $60

- Big (long or footage-heavy): $85

I assign the tier when I send the footage. If a video turns out to

be more work than I called it, tell me and I'll raise it. Rates

also grow with speed and quality over time.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully, this is stage 1 of 3)

Send me:

1. A screenshot of the COMPLETE timeline of the last long-form

   video you edited, zoomed out so the entire video fits on

   screen. I want to see how you actually work: your tracks, your

   b-roll, your cuts.

2. One or two sentences on your editing experience.

3. Confirm you can run Premiere 25.6.3 and meet a 48 hour

   turnaround.



EXTRA CREDIT: also send a short screen recording of you playing

one of your edits inside Premiere, so I can see the timeline, the

cuts, and hear the audio while it plays. This is optional but it

moves you to the front of the line.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

- Stage 2: if your timeline looks right, I send you ONE clip and

  ask you to edit it and send back the project file. It's one

  clip, so it's quick and unpaid. This just confirms you can

  deliver a clean file in my version.

- Stage 3: if that's clean, I send you a full real video as a PAID

  test at the rates above. Do well and you have the ongoing role.



Applications that skip the timeline screenshot or ignore the

version requirement won't be considered.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative

(Sparkblaze Digital)



Location: Remote (Work from Home) / Hybrid

Salary: PHP 20,000 - PHP 60,000/month DOE (Depending on Experience) + Commission/Incentives

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Schedule: Eastern Standard Time (EST) or Flexible - Monday to Friday



About Sparkblaze Digital



Sparkblaze Digital is a full-service digital marketing agency dedicated to helping startups and growing businesses ignite growth with innovative, results-driven strategies. Our team builds and manages data-driven campaigns — from paid advertising and SEO to landing pages and conversion rate optimization — that generate measurable ROI for our clients.



We work across a wide range of industries, including e-commerce, B2B, SaaS, finance, real estate, home services, and local businesses, helping each one scale smarter and grow faster with tailored strategies. We are a fully remote team transitioning to a hybrid set-up, and we are looking for experienced, high-performing talent to help accelerate our agency's growth.



What You'll Do



As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will own the top-of-funnel of Sparkblaze Digital's sales pipeline. Your primary focus is prospecting, qualifying, and nurturing leads, then booking well-prepped discovery calls for our closing team — setting them up to convert qualified prospects into long-term agency clients. You act as the critical bridge between our marketing/intake team and our sales closers.



Your responsibilities may include:



- Prospecting and identifying potential clients who match our ideal buyer profile, primarily within the education, consulting, and other B2B service industries.

- Qualifying inbound leads generated by our marketing campaigns, and conducting outbound outreach (calls,
, and messaging) to build a healthy pipeline.

- Researching each prospect's business and current online presence to understand their needs before outreach, so conversations are relevant and informed.

- Nurturing warm leads over time through consistent, personalized follow-up until they're ready for a deeper sales conversation.

- Booking discovery calls and qualified meetings for the closing team, and preparing clear handoff notes on each prospect's needs, budget, and goals.

- Accurately logging all prospect interactions, pipeline stages, and lead details in the CRM system to keep data current for the wider sales team.

- Collaborating closely with the marketing and intake teams to ensure lead quality, timely follow-through, and a smooth handoff process.

- Using CRM and AI-assisted tools to prioritize high-potential accounts and streamline outreach.

- Contributing insights from prospect conversations to help refine messaging, targeting, and outreach strategy.

- Meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly targets for qualified meetings booked and pipeline generated.



What Are We Looking For?



We are looking for a driven top-of-funnel specialist with a genuine interest in digital marketing and paid media. You don't need to be a closer — you need to be excellent at opening doors, qualifying opportunities, and setting our sales team up to win.



You should have:



- This role is also open to fresh graduates. Individuals who graduated a 4-year degree course with 1–3 years of experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), appointment setter, business development representative (BDR), or similar prospecting and lead-qualification role — agency or digital marketing experience is a plus.

- Comfort with outbound prospecting (cold calling,
ing, and social outreach) as well as qualifying inbound leads.

- A working understanding of paid advertising concepts (Meta Ads, Google Ads, and sales funnels) to speak credibly with prospects.

- Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar) for logging activity, tracking pipeline, and reporting.

- Strong research skills — able to review a prospect's online footprint and identify relevant marketing gaps ahead of a call.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for building rapport quickly and asking effective qualifying questions.

- Persistence and resilience — comfortable with rejection and consistent, disciplined follow-up.

mbers.



### Requirements



* Strong expertise in QuickBooks Online, including transaction review, reconciliations, corrections, cleanup work, and troubleshooting.

* Strong written English skills for frequent client

### Preferred Qualifications (but not required)



* Experience with nonprofit bookkeeping or nonprofit accounting.

* Familiarity with Ramp, Gusto, Stripe, PayPal, Excel, Google Workspace, Hubdoc, and QuickBooks Payroll.

This position will begin part-time at approximately 20 hours per week. As our client base grows, we expect the role to transition to full-time after approximately 6 months. 5. Nonprofit Experience

Please describe any experience you have with nonprofit bookkeeping or nonprofit accounting. If you do not have nonprofit experience, please state that clearly. 



6. Review and Feedback Experience

Please describe your experience reviewing another bookkeeper’s work, identifying errors, and giving feedback to help improve accuracy.



7. Written English Communication

Please briefly describe your experience communicating with clients by
, including requesting information, following up on open items, and explaining bookkeeping-related questions.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO — US Automotive Company (Full-Time, 7 Days/Week, On-Call)
description:
?? READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING

Most people should not apply to this job. I'm going to tell you exactly why, so you don't waste your time or mine.



THE THREE HARD REQUIREMENTS

1. THERE IS NO SCHEDULE. WHEN WORK CALLS, YOU ANSWER.

This is the most important sentence in this post: there are no set hours.

I am not going to tell you to work 9 to 6. I'm going to send you a task at 7 AM, and another at 2 PM, and another at 8 PM, and sometimes on a Sunday. When something needs to be done, it needs to be done — not "tomorrow when my shift starts."

What this actually looks like day to day:



Some days are quiet. Two hours of work and you're done.

Some days are heavy. Calls, portals, documents, back and forth all day.

You will not know which kind of day it is when you wake up.

7 days a week. Saturday and Sunday are normal days here.

You are expected to see a message and respond within a reasonable window, all day, every day.



The total volume averages roughly 40–45 hours per week. It is not 70. But it is spread across all seven days and it does not respect a calendar. I do not need messages between 11 PM and 7 AM Eastern. Outside that window, assume you're reachable.

If you want a fixed schedule, a defined shift, or protected weekends — do not apply. You will be unhappy here and I will have wasted your time.

I am not apologizing for this. It's the job. I'm paying above market specifically because of it. Read that sentence twice and d
.

2. YOUR SPOKEN ENGLISH MUST BE EXCELLENT

You will be on the phone with Americans every single day — vendors, tow yards, government agencies, insurance companies. Not scripts. Real conversations where you have to understand a fast-talking American on a bad connection and get what you need out of him.

Written English is not enough. If you write beautifully but freeze on a live call, this is not your job.

A video is mandatory. No video, no consideration. Details below.

3. YOU MUST BE ABLE TO FIGURE THINGS OUT

I will not give you step-by-step instructions. I will tell you the outcome I need and expect you to work out how.

If your instinct when you get stuck is to wait for me to explain — this will not work. If your instinct is to try three things, then come to me with a specific question, we'll get along.



ABOUT US

A Florida-based automotive group: a 130+ vehicle rental fleet, a body shop, and a tech platform. Small team, no bureaucracy, direct access to the owner. Do good work and you get more responsibility and more money quickly. This is not a corporation with an HR department.

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Call US vendors, tow yards, and government agencies — get information, push things through, follow up until it's done

Manage tasks, notes, and databases in Notion (we'll train you)

Research: pricing, vendors, regulations, competitors — and give me a short clear summary with a recommendation, not a pile of links

Chase documents and signatures; keep trackers current

Navigate web portals: government sites, payment systems, toll accounts

Draft
s and messages on my behalf

Send me a short end-of-day report every day: done / blocked / next



REQUIREMENTS



Available 7 days a week, all day, no fixed schedule — see above

Excellent spoken English, minimal accent — see above

Strong, stable internet. Backup power/internet is a serious plus.

Quiet workspace, working headset, webcam

Extremely organized. Nothing falls through the cracks.

Follows instructions precisely — and asks when something is unclear instead of guessing

Works without being chased

Comfortable with Google Workspace



Plus: experience with US companies, automotive, insurance, or logistics. Notion or CRM experience. Any bookkeeping or QuickBooks exposure.

COMPENSATION

$1,300–1,600/month, depending on experience. The top of that range is a premium for the schedule — I know what I'm asking for.



Paid twice monthly via Wise or Deel

90-day review with a raise for strong performers

Paid time off after 6 months

Long-term role. I'm looking for someone to grow with the business, not a temp.





HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY

Applications that miss any step are deleted without being read. This is the first test.

1. Start your message with the word ORANGE.

2. One line: confirm you understand there is no fixed schedule, that this is 7 days a week, and that you're accepting that.

3. Record a 60-second video. Unscripted. In English. Do not read from a page — I will know. Tell me:



Who you are

One time you solved a problem when nobody told you how



This video is the single most important part of your application. Bad audio is fine. Reading a script is not.

4. In one paragraph, answer this: If I asked you to find the cheapest way to transport a car from Miami to Chicago, and gave you no other information, what would you do?

5. Tell me one thing you're genuinely good at that isn't on this list.

Shortlisted candidates get $50 for a short, real trial task before any offer. Real work, real money, before either of us commits.
